description: This source file contains test extension methods for CanvasWindowController, providing utilities for session key sanitization, JavaScript string literal encoding, frame storage and retrieval, IPv4 parsing, local network checks, and URL validation, used when compiling in DEBUG mode.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: Extension providing testing utility methods for session management, URL encoding, frame storage, IPv4 parsing, and network checks.

methods.name: _testSanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Test utility for sanitizing session key strings.

methods.name: _testJSStringLiteral
methods.description: Test utility for encoding strings as JavaScript string literals.

methods.name: _testJSOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Test utility for encoding optional strings as JavaScript string literals.

methods.name: _testStoredFrameKey
methods.description: Test utility for generating stored frame keys based on session keys.

methods.name: _testStoreAndLoadFrame
methods.description: Test utility for storing and loading window frames.

methods.name: _testParseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into a tuple of four UInt8 values.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a given IPv4 address tuple belongs to a local network.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Determines if the URL points to a local network resource.
